violation_type.title: Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §742.501(3))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, the caregiver did not give proper attention to physical needs of the child as the caregiver propped a bottle for a four-month-old infant and then walked away without providing adequate supervision.

finding_variants.text: Based on the DFPS investigation, the caregiver did not give proper attention to physical needs of the child as the caregiver propped a bottle for a four-month-old infant and then walked away without providing adequate supervision.
This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. It was determined that staff have not diapered children promptly.
This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. Per interviews conducted it was determined children's diapers have not been changed promptly.
